output_schema.description: JSON object with 'stations' array (sorted by station_id) and 'summary' object.

station_object.station_id: string matching station key (S1 through S6)
station_object.feasibility_class: FEASIBLE if max_wrench_scale >= feasible_min_scale, MARGINAL if >= marginal_min_scale, else INFEASIBLE
station_object.max_wrench_scale: non-negative float: largest factor s >= 0 such that the robot can sustain s times the required wrench without any joint exceeding its torque limit, with all static loads (gravity, payload) included
station_object.limiting_joints: array of 0-indexed joint indices whose torque utilization at max_wrench_scale exceeds limiting_joint_utilization threshold
station_object.condition_number: positive float: ratio of largest to smallest singular value of the 6x7 Jacobian at the tool tip
station_object.is_near_singular: boolean: true if condition_number exceeds singularity_condition_number threshold
station_object.manipulability: non-negative float: Yoshikawa manipulability index at the tool tip
station_object.torque_utilization: 7-element array: |total_torque_i| / torque_limit_i when sustaining the full required wrench (scale=1.0), including all static loads

summary_object.station_ranking: array of station_id strings sorted by max_wrench_scale descending
